svg.aria-label: Animated diagram of a store's dynamic partition: chunks are filed under the posting with the nearest centre; a posting past the split limit is split in two by 2-means and retired; a chunk that a new centre now beats is reassigned; a posting shrunk by deletes to the merge limit is folded into a nearby posting with room. No code is rewritten, so moved chunks keep the centre they were encoded against, and retired centres stay stored.
svg.text: Chunks stay where they are. What changes is the posting each one is filed under, and the centres that route new chunks.
code written against its posting's centre
centre kept, no posting routes by it
POSTINGS AND THEIR SIZE, IN CHUNKS

g.text: retired: never searched, holds no chunks
retired: never searched, holds no chunks
retired: never searched, holds no chunks
A store starts with one posting, P0. Its centre is the zero vector.
Documents arrive. Each chunk goes to P0, the only posting, and its code is written against P0's centre.
Every chunk is filed under the posting whose centre is nearest. So far that is always P0.
P0 now holds 9 chunks, more than the split limit (8). The write wakes maintenance.
Split: 2-means divides P0's chunks in two. Each half, P1 and P2, is centred on the mean of its chunks. P0 is retired.
Reassign finds nothing to move. No code was rewritten: every chunk's code still refers to P0's centre, so every chunk is hollow.
New chunks go to the nearest centre. The chunk at the top edge is only just nearer P2 than P1.
P1 now holds 9 chunks: past the split limit again.
Split: P1's chunks are divided between P3 and P4. P1 is retired.
Reassign: the edge chunk of P2 is now nearer P4's centre than both P1's old centre and P2's own, so it moves to P4.
Documents are deleted. P3 is down to 2 chunks: at the merge limit.
Merge: P3 folds into P4, the nearest posting with room (2 + 5 < 8). The larger, P4, keeps its centre. P3 is retired.
Retired postings are never searched. Their centres stay stored, because the hollow chunks' codes still refer to them.

svg.text: Illustrative: a split limit of 8 and a merge limit of 2 chunks (the defaults are 256 and 22), in 2 dimensions instead of 768. The real partition works on the chunks' code reconstructions.
